coordinates.quote: located in a test-beam hall on CERN’s Prévessin site

name: CERN Neutrino Platform, EHN1 (Prévessin site)
notes: facility:cern is owned by the cern-atlas workstream; this record only references it.

summary.plain: A large hall at CERN, on the French side of the laboratory, where full-size prototypes of the DUNE detectors were built and tested in a particle beam.
summary.technical: EHN1 extension in the CERN North Area on the Prévessin site, housing the CERN Neutrino Platform test beams and the ProtoDUNE single-phase and dual-phase cryostats, as well as ICARUS refurbishment and Baby MIND.
